Role: Photographer & Retoucher

Overview: A dedicated photography project designed to capture the vibrant essence, textures, and intricate details of a cocktail bar's signature drinks.

My Responsibilities:

Photography & Composition: Executed the entire photoshoot, meticulously choosing the right angles and lighting to highlight the unique character of each cocktail.

Post-Production: Handled all color grading, retouching, and mood enhancement using Adobe Lightroom.
